propositions: Step-budget exhaustion raises LLMRunnerError which does not match the UnretryableOutputError catch clause in CompletionAgentStep.run, preventing bounded completion recovery from executing.
The catch clause in CompletionAgentStep.run only checks for UnretryableOutputError with token exhaustion, leaving budget exhaustion errors to propagate uncaught.
LLMBudgetExhaustedError must be introduced as a distinct typed exception subclass of LLMRunnerError to enable type-based routing to recovery without message or shape sniffing.
The except spine in CompletionAgentStep.run must be extended to catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError and route it to _recover, preserving the budget diagnostic for failure reporting.
Recovery must remain fail-closed when criterion coverage cannot be produced, never converting failures into unearned passes.
